children: of $500M aggregate principal amount of 1.625% convertible senior notes due 2031.
The offering size was increased by $100M to $500M from the previously announced $400M, with settlement scheduled for September 14, 2026.
The initial purchasers were granted a 13-day option to purchase up to an additional $75M in principal amount.

The notes feature an initial conversion price of approximately $31.93 per share (~31.3161 shares per $1,000 principal), representing a 32.5% premium over BKV’s September 9, 2026 closing price of $24.10 per share.

The notes bear interest at 1.625% per annum, payable semi-annually on April 15 and October 15, beginning April 15, 2027, and mature on October 15, 2031, unless earlier repurchased, redeemed, or converted.

BKV expects net proceeds of ~$481.8M ($554.7M if the over-allotment is fully exercised). The company plans to use: $56.3M to fund capped call transactions to mitigate potential share dilution up to a 100% cap price ($48.20 per share). $35M to repurchase 1.45M shares of common stock at $24.10 per share. Remaining proceeds for general corporate purposes, including debt repayment and capital expenditures.

In connection with the offering, BKV entered into privately negotiated capped call transactions with initial purchasers and financial institutions covering the shares underlying the notes to mitigate potential equity dilution or cash outlay upon conversion.
The capped call features an initial cap price of $48.20 per share, a 100% premium over BKV's September 9 closing price of $24.10.
